preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.

reader-action.instruction: In the reader-facing setup give each item, its actual current state and its immediate action, in source order. Leave a wanted exempt item alone; protect an affected keeper; individually remove an exempt unwanted item; leave an affected unwanted item for bulk removal. Only then issue the bulk command and verify what remains. Evaluate the bulk command on the state left by the setup actions; entries already removed cannot survive it.

concise-helpful-wording.instruction: Use direct, helpful wording and remove redundancy only when no needed meaning is lost.

consistent-terms.instruction: For controls defined in prose, separate each grammatical subject (literal control name) from its full finite verb phrase (effect) in a short key. The label alone belongs after “select.” A label that consumes the action verb or entire sentence cannot identify the control. Preserve explicitly marked labels, code and identifiers.

global-comprehension.instruction: Prefer literal, context-independent wording over culture-bound idioms and unexplained references.
